title: Reactivating uses the same bulk mode and bar, worded Activate
custom_preconds:
1. You are on the Parts -> Inventory page on the build under test, with permission to view inventory parts.
  2. You hold the "Part Library & Inventory - Delete" permission (needed to change status/tracking).
  3. Some inactive parts exist; you are on the Inactive tab.
custom_steps:
1. Open the actions menu and turn on Activate parts.
  2. Confirm the same checkbox column and bulk bar appear, with the button reading Activate.
  3. Spot-check that the Story-2 behaviours (S2-R3..R10, S2-R14..R18) apply here with wording changed to activate.
custom_expected:
Expected results

  • Reactivation uses the same mode as deactivation: on the Inactive tab the menu entry reads "Activate parts" and turning it on shows the same checkbox column and bulk bar, with an "Activate" button in the same blue as "Deactivate".
  • S2-R3 through S2-R10 and S2-R14 through S2-R18 apply on the Inactive tab exactly as on the Active tab, with the wording changed from deactivate to activate.

Source - where this behaviour comes from
Epic SV-10647; "Parts Lifecycle Update" PRD (Confluence 829227015, IN REVIEW 2026-09-09), Story 3 (Activate parts); design canvas Vz6rprcWyP16tYxzM1kdeE; read 30 Sep 2026. Source-verified 30 September 2026 against an IN-REVIEW spec; not yet build-verified.

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

  • S3-R1: “Reactivation uses the same mode as Story 2. On the Inactive tab the actions menu entry reads "Activate parts" and turning it on shows the same checkbox column and the same bulk bar.”
  • S3-R2: “The bulk bar button reads "Activate". It is the same blue as "Deactivate" on the Active tab.”
  • S3-R5: “S2-R3 through S2-R10 and S2-R14 through S2-R18 apply on the Inactive tab exactly as they do on the Active tab, with the wording changed from deactivate to activate.”
